Convert Long Data to Wide Format

Source: R/utils.R
to_wide.Rd

Converts environmental monitoring data from long format to wide format using analytes as columns.

to_wide(df, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
to_wide(
  df,
  location_id = "location_id",
  sample_date = "sample_date",
  param_name = "param_name",
  analysis_result = "analysis_result",
  lab_id = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'env_schema'
to_wide(df, label = TRUE, result = c("analysis", "display"))

Arguments

df

A data frame or `env_schema` object.

...

Additional information.

location_id

Location column name.

sample_date

Sample date column name.

param_name

Analyte column name.

analysis_result

Analytical result column name.

lab_id

Optional laboratory identifier column.

label

Use analyte display labels as column names.

result

Result representation to use. Defaults to `"analysis"`.

"analysis"

Uses standardized analytical values stored in `.analysis_result`.

"display"

Uses display-ready reporting values stored in `.display_result`.

Value

A data frame in wide format.

Details

`to_wide()` is an S3 generic supporting both `data.frame` and `env_schema` objects.

When `result = "display"`, analyte columns contain display-ready character values derived from `.display_result`, making them suitable for reporting tables and exports.

When `result = "analysis"`, analyte columns contain standardized numeric values from `.analysis_result` suitable for statistical and geochemical calculations.

env_schema Method

For `env_schema` objects, location, date, analyte, and result fields are obtained automatically from schema mappings.
